tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production sprite source for educational YouTube videos. Create a strict3 by3 row-major grid of NINE full-body poses, every cell equal size. Highest native resolution available, transparent RGBA background. Input image1 is the EXACT adopted identity/style reference, not a pixel-edit target. Redraw fresh. The exact adopted Sand tiger shark shown in image1; identity features: 灰褐色の胴・背鰭2・鰓の短線・非対称尾. Remain a simplified bird-like/water-animal PROP, never a humanoid. Preserve precisely the existing anatomical body, wings/fins/flippers/feet/tail that are visible; no human arms, hands, legs, teeth, clothing or anime eyes. Use broad clean colour blocks, no detailed feather barbs or naturalistic diagram. Preserve its exact eye format when open (white surrounds only if the reference has them, same pupil and no added highlights), facial markings, palette, warm brown contours and subtle paper/watercolor texture. No realistic animal proportions or heavy outline change. All poses keep SAME anatomical head/body scale and proportions as the adopted reference, including every resting/blink/crouch state. Lots of true transparent padding around each complete subject and between cells; no cropped horns/gills/bill/tail/feet. No text, labels, grid lines, backgrounds, ground/shadow, props, sparkles, extra animals or duplicate/disconnected limbs. Required reading order left-to-right then top-to-bottom: 1 BLINK: Same exact upright/resting body position, head size, torso length/width, limbs, supports and facing as image1, ONLY the eye(s) gently fully closed as a simple brown lid curve; mouth/expression otherwise unchanged. Do not crouch, nod, shrink or move the body during blink. 2 GREET: Gentle greeting using a small lift of a reference-existing wing/flipper or a small head acknowledgment, anatomy unchanged and no new limbs. 3 PRESENT_LEFT: Direct the bill/head/gaze and an existing wing/flipper if suitable toward VIEWER LEFT; keep real existing anatomy. 4 PRESENT_RIGHT: Naturally turn the head/body to indicate VIEWER RIGHT using only the existing bill/head/wing/flipper. Not a simple flip-copy; preserve asymmetrical markings/anatomy. 5 THINK: A small thoughtful/curious head tilt or downward glance, same dot-eye and body, no human hand. 6 AHA: Small alert discovery: head slightly perks up and existing wing/flipper moves a little if suitable, solid reference eye; no effect. 7 CHEER: Pleased gentle celebration with existing wings/flippers opened a little or body perking naturally. Keep real anatomy and simple eye, no human mouth. 8 SPECIES_A: Keep the same side-facing simplified fish body and gently bend the existing caudal peduncle/tail fin a little upward. 9 SPECIES_B: The same single tail fin sweeps slightly downward, while head/body centre remain stable and all existing fins stay attached. Species constraint: 人の腕・脚を追加しない。ヒゲ・斑・横帯・背鰭・尾の二叉形や非対称形を各原画どおり保つ。地面・水面・泡を追加しない。 Clean bounded color areas and connected silhouettes; no pigment spills, background haze or extra marks. Do not insert an additional neutral; it is reused from image1.
CRITICAL TRANSPARENCY: true RGBA isolated sprites only. Every pixel outside the separated character silhouettes must have alpha 0, including all gutters and all four canvas corners. Do not paint a beige/white/grey paper rectangle, backdrop, floor, contact shadow, border, diffuse halo, ambient shadow, red/yellow low-alpha colour field or speckles. Watercolour texture must be clipped to the characters themselves. Fresh original drawing, no postprocessing.
